code: const storage=()=>window.sessionStorage;export const getAuthToken=()=>storage().getItem('okoa_access_token')||'';export const getRefreshToken=()=>storage().getItem('okoa_refresh_token')||'';export const saveAuthSession=data=>{storage().setItem('okoa_access_token',data.access_token);if(data.refresh_token)storage().setItem('okoa_refresh_token',data.refresh_token);if(data.session_id)storage().setItem('okoa_session_id',data.session_id);};export const clearAuthSession=()=>{storage().removeItem('okoa_access_token');storage().removeItem('okoa_refresh_token');storage().removeItem('okoa_session_id');storage().removeItem('okoa_dashboard_role');};export const refreshAuthToken=async()=>{const refreshToken=getRefreshToken();if(!refreshToken)return false;const response=await fetch("".concat(process.env.REACT_APP_API_URL||'',"/api/auth/refresh"),{method:'POST',headers:{Authorization:"Bearer ".concat(refreshToken)}});const payload=await response.json().catch(()=>({}));if(!response.ok||!payload.access_token){clearAuthSession();return false;}storage().setItem('okoa_access_token',payload.access_token);return true;};
